limitations: Closed UTC calendar day, not a 24-hour holding period for each call.
Entry is the saved signal snapshot reference price, not a proven executable fill.
Only original full 5-minute bars starting after the signal and ending by UTC day end; the first straddling bar is excluded (up to 5 minutes unobserved).
Candle high crossing is an observed threshold, not guaranteed liquidity or execution. TP timestamps are candle ranges, never exact fill times.
Fixed target fills are capped at the target; unsold positions use the last available candle close. No hindsight maximum fills.
3 last-price marks older than 900 seconds are stale. Gap flags include internal or trailing missing bars; no interpolation or fabricated candles.
2 legacy calls predate strict eligibility. Both are preserved and flagged. Only 2 Robinhood calls: inadequate sample for conviction.
All default fee, gas and slippage assumptions are ILLUSTRATIVE, user-editable, and not actual measured fees. No execution simulation or liquidity validation.
Partial strategy submits two separate half-position orders; both incur exit gas, including same-candle targets or two day-close marks.
Curve is cumulative independent-call net P&L in signal order, not portfolio NAV, compounded equity, or a capital-constrained simulation.
One day of data is descriptive, not evidence of out-of-sample edge. Addresses are preserved verbatim, including malformed-looking source tokens.
metadata.source: Frozen complete cohort and original cached GMGN page responses; no network calls
